name: Harb Clawhoof
summary: Near Bloodhoof Village, Harb Clawhoof tends the tauren’s kodos. He offers them to worthy tauren riders and trusted champions of Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Breeder of the Great Kodo
sections.body: Harb Clawhoof tends the kodos near Bloodhoof Village. These great beasts carry heavy loads across long distances and are vital to tauren travel and work on the plains. Harb cares for each one, trains it, and pairs it with riders respected by the tauren people.

sections.title: Steeds of the Plains
sections.body: Tauren earn the trust needed to ride Harb’s kodos, while outsiders face closer scrutiny. Their size and temperament make kodos difficult for those unfamiliar with them to guide. Non-tauren allies must prove their loyalty and earn exalted standing with Thunder Bluff before riding one of Harb’s mounts.

faq.q: Where can I find Harb Clawhoof?
faq.answer: Harb Clawhoof tends the kodo corral on the outskirts of Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore, just south of Thunder Bluff.
Harb sells several kinds of kodo mounts, including brown and gray kodos and heavily armored great kodos for seasoned riders.

faq.q: Can non-tauren buy kodos from Harb?
faq.answer: Yes. Tauren can buy kodos directly, while other Horde races must earn exalted standing with Thunder Bluff and prove themselves to the tribe before Harb entrusts them with one.

faq.q: Why are kodos so important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Kodos suit the tauren’s nomadic life and the open plains of central Kalimdor. They carry burdens, serve as war mounts, and transport trade across the rugged land.

angles.text: As a tauren, Harb Clawhoof offers you a mount tied to your heritage, useful for travel across Mulgore and bound to your nomadic traditions.
As an orc, troll, or Forsaken, earning a kodo from Harb marks honor and friendship recognized by the elders of Thunder Bluff.
